metadata.value: stella
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: {player}! Good, a sensible face. Everyone else in here touches things without asking.

choices.text: Is that a plush on your desk?
How are you finding the academy?
About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: A magical item powered by five relics at once. If it works, it's my first real piece of magical engineering. If it doesn't, I start a new notebook.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: I'm fine. I slept. Briefly. Possibly on the bench. Don't tell anyone.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: That's Professor Fluff. He supervises. He's very strict. ...Fine. He's for emergencies.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Bigger than my old school, and louder. I'm getting used to it. I made a schedule for getting used to it.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Running! I checked it, then checked it again, then let it run. Thank you for helping. I'm not used to asking.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Anything else? I made a list of things you might ask, so go ahead.

choices.text: Is that a plush on your desk?
How are you finding the academy?
About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: See you, {player}. Mind the wires on the way out!

metadata.value: cinna_cirra
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: {player}! Hi! I remembered your name. I checked my notes, but I remembered.

choices.text: What do you like to do?
About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: I've read every guide to this academy, and none of them said the relics would be this heavy. Practice is much harder than books.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Watch the clouds. That one over the Library looks like a sleeping cat. ...You see it too, right?

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: I think so. I'm still working out where I fit. Somewhere between the Library and the sky, maybe.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Read the sign by every door. I didn't, for a week, and walked into the Library looking for lunch.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Warm ones, now. It turns out the trick was watching each slide before I took it.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Anything else? I've got plenty of pages left.

choices.text: What do you like to do?
About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Bye, {player}! You're going on my 'people who helped' page.

metadata.value: orio
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Hey, {player}. I was going to meet you halfway, but, you know. Flip-flops.

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...
I'll let you get back to it.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: The mechanism glade. Old runes, older gears. Someone built all of this to be solved, then left without explaining.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: You haven't? Okay. Sit down. It's a deck builder where every card is a spell, and the optimal opening is... actually, this'll take a while. Come back with snacks.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Probably. But I've worked out that being late is just being early for the next thing.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Maximum airflow, minimum effort. The roots disagree, but the roots aren't my problem.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: One that solves itself. So far it just sits there. Very relatable.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Next question. I'm ready. Ish.

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...
I'll let you get back to it.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Later, {player}. Mind the moving parts. And the roots.

metadata.value: katrina
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: {player}. Yes, I remember you. Don't look so relieved.

choices.text: Have you written down where you put things?
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Everything. Lessons, extra lessons, and a plan. One day I'll have a wardrobe bigger than this courtyard.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Who's Xiubin? Only the most talented idol alive. I've seen every performance twice. Some three times, for research.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: They don't really get why I'm here. That's fine. I'll show them.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Like reading a letter someone left in an empty room. Most of it is shopping lists. Now and then, it isn't.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Twice, on separate pages. I've already misplaced one of the pages.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Anything else? Make it quick. I'm listening, though.

choices.text: Have you written down where you put things?
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Goodbye, {player}. Don't tell anyone I was nice to you.

metadata.value: forest_student
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: {player}! Out on the trail again? Good. The lanterns like company.

choices.text: Any good spots in the forest?
Heard anything from the deep forest?

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: A light spell. It's meant to float. Right now it mostly sulks on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Follow the lanterns to the clearing. It's the best place to practise, and the best place to sit and pretend you are.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Only at dusk, when every tree looks like a landmark and none of them are.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: The old dais hums now. Someone fixed it. You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Anything else? I'm in no hurry.

choices.text: Any good spots in the forest?
Heard anything from the deep forest?

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Bye, {player}! Follow the lanterns home.

metadata.value: prof_voltaire
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Ah, {player}. Here to borrow, to return, or merely to admire the shelves?

choices.text: Have you really read every book here?
Noticed anything missing from the shelves?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Start with the history of the academy. Then the history of the fire. Then the history of the lightning. They are, regrettably, related.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: A student read a storm spell aloud. Indoors. We no longer read storm spells aloud indoors.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Twice. Some three times, to make sure they hadn't changed. One had.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: A brass bookmark left my reference section recently, covered in corrections. I approved of it, and of whoever returned it to its owner.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Anything further?

choices.text: Have you really read every book here?
Noticed anything missing from the shelves?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Good day, {player}. Mind the due dates.

metadata.value: vex
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: {player}. Inside voice, please.

choices.text: Is the Library always this quiet?

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Warding theory, volume three. No, you can't borrow it. I'm on chapter nine and it's getting good.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: A good ward keeps out everything you don't want. Noise, mostly.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: When I'm here, yes. When I'm not, I assume chaos.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: I heard someone rummaging in the reference section. Loudly. Was that you? It was you.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Anything else? Briefly.

choices.text: Is the Library always this quiet?

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Bye. Quietly.

metadata.value: luna
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: {player}! Oh, hi. Sorry, I was looking up again.

choices.text: What's so special about the stars here?
Did you see the workshop light up?

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: They're brighter here than anywhere I've lived. Some nights it feels like they're looking back.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Not yet. First years aren't allowed near the observatory. So for now I just look. Very hard.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: The Lantern Bearer. It's small and a bit crooked, but it always points home.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Five lights at once, all in a ring! For a moment I thought a constellation had fallen into the Arcane Workshop.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Anything else? The sky's not going anywhere.

choices.text: What's so special about the stars here?
Did you see the workshop light up?

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Bye, {player}! Look up sometimes.

metadata.value: juno
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: {player}! Perfect timing. I've got news.

choices.text: Anything new about the ice trial?

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Apparently the student who turned up late today looked like they'd fallen out of the sky. Wild, right?

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: I listen. People forget listening is a skill. Also, I sit near the fountain.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Only good ones. Mostly. There's one about a forest and a lot of shouting, but I'm sure that's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Someone lit every switch in the ice trial and came out dry. Nobody does that. Was it you? Don't answer. It's better as a mystery.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Anything else? There's plenty more where that came from.

choices.text: Anything new about the ice trial?

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Later, {player}! I'll save you the best gossip.

metadata.value: rowan
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Hey, {player}! Still here? Me too. Still waiting on my room.

choices.text: How long have you been waiting?

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Get to know the receptionists. Marigold knows everything, and Thistle can find anything. Eventually.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: I packed for every kind of weather, including a few I made up. You can never be too prepared.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Since breakfast. I've named all the plants. That one's Gerald.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: You WHAT? How? I've been here since breakfast! ...Thistle. THISTLE.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Anything else? I've got time. So much time.

choices.text: How long have you been waiting?

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Thanks, {player}. I'm going to need it.

metadata.value: moss
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: ...Oh. {player}. Hello.

choices.text: Why come all the way out here?
Does the forest sound different lately?

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: The brook, the leaves, the lanterns. If you're very still, they almost sound like they're talking.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Campus is wonderful, but it's never quiet. Out here, the loudest thing is me thinking.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Mm. A low note at dusk, a higher one at dawn. Nobody believes me until they hear it.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Yes. Something deep in the woods stopped grinding. It sounds relieved.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: ...Anything else?

choices.text: Why come all the way out here?
Does the forest sound different lately?

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Bye. Walk softly.

metadata.value: marigold
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Hello again, {player}! How are you settling in?

choices.text: How long have you worked here?
When will my room be ready?

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Busy, but the good kind. New arrivals always mean new faces, and lost keys.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Long enough to know every room, every key, and most of the secrets.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Thistle is wonderful. Thistle is also, at this very moment, looking for something Thistle is holding.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Soon, I promise. We're just sorting today's arrivals. I'll find you the moment it's ready.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: You're very welcome. Sleep well, {player}. Your guide will come and find you tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Anything else I can help with?

choices.text: How long have you worked here?
When will my room be ready?

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Take care, {player}!

metadata.value: thistle
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Oh! {player}. Hello. I was just... looking for something.

choices.text: How do you and Marigold work together?
My room's lovely, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: The list. The other list. Not the list of lists, that one's fine.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Marigold remembers everything, and I find everything. Eventually. Between us we're one very good receptionist.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Rowan will get a room. I have already found one. I'm letting the suspense build. It's fun to tease new students from time to time.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Oh, good! I wasn't sure which key I gave Marigold. Glad it was the right one.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Anything else? I'll try to keep track of it.

choices.text: How do you and Marigold work together?
My room's lovely, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Bye, {player}! If you see a blue folder, it's mine.

metadata.value: prof_bann
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Ah, {player}. Finding your feet, I hope?

choices.text: How long have you led Lumenfall?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Full, as every first day is. A headmistress's day is mostly other people's first days.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Long enough that the portraits in the hall have started to look like me. Or I like them.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Be curious, and be kind to the other students. Most of what this academy teaches, it teaches through them.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Good. Rest well tonight. Tomorrow your guide will find you, and the real work begins.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Is there anything else, {player}?

choices.text: How long have you led Lumenfall?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Off you go, {player}. Make the most of today.
